title: Smooth cutoff ϑ (= 1 on B_r(0), 0 ≤ ϑ ≤ 1) and the test form ϑ·β
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, r > 0 and β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, n). Then there exist ϑ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) such that: ϑ is continuous with compact support; 0 ≤ ϑ(x) ≤ 1 for all x; ϑ(x) = 1 whenever ‖x‖ < r; and ω(x) = ϑ(x)·β for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (β : Covector (Euclid P) n), 0 < r → ∃ (ϑ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Continuous ϑ ∧ HasCompactSupport ϑ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ϑ x ∧ ϑ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, ‖x‖ < r → ϑ x = 1) ∧ ∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = ϑ x • β
